metadata.name: rug_royale_v2
metadata.description: Rug Royale v2: 1v1 paper-trading duels on live prices (MagicBlock ER)

docs: `#[ephemeral]` injects `process_undelegation`, the callback MagicBlock's Delegation
Program invokes to hand `Match` back to this program after `finalize_match` commits and
undelegates it. It must sit before `#[program]`.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: (default) pubkey as a writable account.

accounts.name: match_account
docs: owner and status are checked in the handler. `del` makes `#[delegate]` add the
buffer / record / metadata accounts and `delegate_match_account`.

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury must be a funded, rent-exempt system account

errors.name: InvalidWindowSet
errors.msg: Windows must be a non-zero ascending prefix

errors.name: InvalidBankroll
errors.msg: Bankroll must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidStartDelay
errors.msg: Start delay is out of range

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: Window is not one of the arena's windows

errors.name: EntryOutOfRange
errors.msg: Entry is outside the allowed range

errors.name: DeadlineTooFar
errors.msg: Join deadline is too far in the future

errors.name: CannotJoinOwnMatch
errors.msg: Creator cannot join their own match

errors.name: OpponentNotAllowed
errors.msg: Signer is not the allowed opponent

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: SponsorMismatch
errors.msg: Match already has a different sponsor

errors.name: SponsorTooSmall
errors.msg: First sponsorship is below the 0.01 SOL minimum

errors.name: NotAParticipant
errors.msg: Signer is not a participant in this match

errors.name: InvalidAsset
errors.msg: Asset index is out of range

errors.name: AssetDisabled
errors.msg: Asset is disabled for new buys

errors.name: WrongPriceFeed
errors.msg: Price feed does not match the arena asset

errors.name: LimitPriceExceeded
errors.msg: Price is past the limit price

errors.name: MarkWindowMissed
errors.msg: No valid mark price within the mark window

errors.name: MatchStillDelegated
errors.msg: Match is still delegated to the ER

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Join deadline has not been reached

errors.name: MatchStillLive
errors.msg: Match is still open or active

types.name: Arena
docs: Seeds `["arena", arena_id.to_le_bytes()]`. Base only; cloned read-only into the ER.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 = LIVE_PRICE_DUEL.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks create/join only.

fields.name: asset_count
docs: 1..=MAX_ASSETS; entries at index >= asset_count are zeroed.

fields.name: windows
docs: Seconds, a non-zero ascending prefix; 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: bankroll
docs: Virtual bankroll per seat, micro-USD.

fields.name: start_delay_secs
docs: Q2: delay from join to the start of trading.

fields.name: freeroll_daily_cap
docs: D4: sponsored freerolls per wallet per day.

types.name: ArenaArgs
docs: Every `Arena` field except `arena_id` (seed), `mode` (always LIVE_PRICE_DUEL in v2.1)
and `bump`.

fields.name: feed
docs: Oracle feed PDA `["price_feed", "pyth-lazer", <lazer_id>]` (checked off-chain at setup).

fields.name: exponent
docs: |exponent| from Pyth's list (e.g. 8 for SOL, 10 for BONK). The feed account's own
exponent field is never read (spike 01: it says 8 for every feed).

fields.name: enabled
docs: Disabled: no new buys; sells and valuation still work.

fields.name: allowed_opponent
docs: Default = anyone may join.

fields.name: session_key
docs: V5: browser-held key that may sign `trade` for this seat. Default = wallet only.

fields.name: validator
docs: V4 / D6: ER validator identity (region) pinned at delegation.

types.name: Match
docs: Seeds `["match", creator, nonce.to_le_bytes()]`. Base while Open; delegated to the ER
from `delegate_match` until `finalize_match` commits and undelegates it (V1).
FIXED LAYOUT (G9): `status` @ 8. Do not reorder or insert fields.

fields.name: result
docs: RESULT_PENDING | RESULT_CREATOR | RESULT_OPPONENT | RESULT_TIE

fields.name: asset_count
docs: Copied from the arena at create.

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: Snapshotted from the arena at create so admin changes never touch a live match (I9).

fields.name: seats
docs: [creator, opponent]

fields.name: final_values
docs: Micro-USD.

fields.name: mark_prices
docs: Raw feed price used per asset at finalize (audit trail); 0 when unused.

fields.name: mark_publish_time
docs: Oldest `publish_time` among the marks used.

fields.name: refunded_entry
docs: Entry + fee share returned to the creator.

types.name: PlayerStats
docs: Seeds `["player", wallet]`. Freeroll cap (V9) plus lifetime stats.

fields.name: day
docs: `unix_ts / 86_400` of the last freeroll counted.

types.name: Pot
docs: Seeds `["pot", match]`. Holds the real SOL; base only, never delegated (V1, G1).
FIXED LAYOUT (G9). No `Option` fields; `Pubkey::default()` means unset. Lobby `memcmp`
filters read the offsets below (mirrored in packages/sdk/src/v2/layout.ts). Do not
reorder or insert fields.

fields.name: match_fee_lamports
docs: F, snapshotted from Protocol at create.

fields.name: fee_share_lamports
docs: ceil(F/2) if entry == 0, else 0 (V7, Q1).

fields.name: settler_tip_lamports
docs: Snapshotted at create.

fields.name: rake_bps
docs: Snapshotted at create.

fields.name: end_ts
docs: Set at join.

fields.name: opponent
docs: Default until joined.

fields.name: allowed_opponent
docs: Default = anyone.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Default = none.

fields.name: validator
docs: ER validator identity (region) pinned at delegation (V4).

types.name: Protocol
docs: Seeds `["protocol"]`. Global caps, admin-adjustable behind a Squads multisig (V2).

fields.name: admin
docs: Squads vault on mainnet.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Rent-exempt system account (checked at init/update).

fields.name: max_entry_lamports
docs: Global entry cap; 0 = free play only (Stage 2).

fields.name: match_fee_lamports
docs: D1: reimburses the joiner's MagicBlock delegation fee.

fields.name: settler_tip_lamports
docs: <= MAX_SETTLER_TIP_LAMPORTS.

fields.name: max_rake_bps
docs: <= MAX_FEE_BPS; arenas cannot exceed it.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks create/join/sponsor; never blocks exits (cancel, settle, refund, close).

types.name: ProtocolArgs
docs: The numeric `Protocol` fields. `admin` is the signer (init) or an explicit argument
(update); `treasury` is an account.

types.name: ProtocolUpdated
docs: v2 PRD §8. Notifications only; clients read state from accounts.

fields.name: session_key
docs: V5: may sign `trade` for this seat only, while the window is open. Default = wallet only.

fields.name: cash
docs: Micro-USD.

fields.name: qty
docs: Per arena asset, 1e-6 token units.
